name: chatgpt-threads
description: Inspect logged-in ChatGPT threads through the local Chrome Bridge with explicit tab/profile selection.

interface.shortDescription: Read ChatGPT thread lists and messages from selected logged-in Chrome tabs.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT Threads uses the local Chrome Bridge to inspect chatgpt.com in a selected Chrome tab/profile. It searches Chrome history, lists visible ChatGPT tabs, reads visible sidebar threads, and extracts messages from the current or requested ChatGPT thread without reading cookies, local storage, or browser profile databases.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the ChatGPT Threads helper to inspect my logged-in ChatGPT threads through Chrome Bridge.
